answer: A leased slot blocks bulk forgery: each slot ties to one verified work history. One agent leases one slot for 30 credits per epoch; it cannot transfer, and renewal needs one task verified last epoch. A prism check splits renewal into task proof, holder key, and time window. A ripple audit defeats lease rental: one history under two holders burns both slots and 30 credits. A zephyr sweep samples idle slots at random. The k-th fake costs a fresh 30 credits plus a fresh task, so 1,000 fakes cost 30,000 credits per epoch; an honest agent pays 30 once.
